## Summary

Describe the change, its user-visible effect, and whether it affects the prototype runtime, legal copy, data handling, workflows, or deployment.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm ci` completed from the lockfile.
- [ ] Dependency audit, TypeScript checks, tests, runtime integrity check, and production build pass.
- [ ] The change uses synthetic demonstration data only.
- [ ] No token, credential, private endpoint, participant record, precise location, or confidential match formula was added.
- [ ] New or changed dependencies and GitHub Actions are necessary and reviewed.
- [ ] Any user-controlled value is validated and safely rendered.
- [ ] Approximate-zone, consent, administrative-review, and controlled-beta guardrails remain intact.
- [ ] No screen implies guaranteed transportation, automatic payment, live dispatch, guaranteed earnings, or unrestricted public access.
- [ ] Deployment changes include a rollback path.

## Security impact

State whether this change affects public-repository boundaries, browser storage, data collection, authorization assumptions, legal/privacy notices, GitHub Actions, or deployment.
